@@81328078 <h> Post <p> FERC Commissioner Rich Glick in his dissent to the CAISO FERC Order provides a prudent recommendation to help guide the energy transition : " the way to manage the transition to the electricity grid of the future is to identify clear , resource-neutral definitions of the services that the system operator will need to operate the grid safely , economically , and reliability and then put in place transparent , market-based solutions for procuring those services . " <p> Commissioner Glick is describing one of the key components of an Always on Capacity Exchange proposal , a market-based solution for procuring grid services , currently under consideration by NAESB for it 's 2020 Annual planning process in the Wholesale Electric Quadrant . A Priority Services Hierarchy ( PSH ) defines the type of services that may be bought/sold within a Capacity Exchange . These service offerings , by qualified supply resources , are placed into the Capacity Exchange as offers to " sell a service " indicating a delivery location , i.e. Central Mass , price and quantity for each type of service offering . Buyers , any qualified party with sufficient financial resources , may @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ a corresponding bid that aligns with the offer , resulting in a " clearing of the bid/offer " at an agreed to location , price and duration ( commitment period ) . ISO 's issue capacity supply obligations to these established capacity commitments based on 1 , State Energy Targets for renewable energy and 2 the PSH , in sufficient quantities to meet reliability requirements . So , what does a PSH contain ? <p> The current strawman PSH identifies 12 unique service types , with more expected to be identified through a consensus-based standards development initiative . @@81331876 <h> Share : <h> New England moose deaths still worsening as climate warms <p> ACTON , Maine ( AP ) -- The devastating toll of ticks on New England 's moose herd has caused the region 's population to shrink , and experts worry it could get worse with climate change . <p> The northern New England states are home to thousands of moose , but the herd has dwindled in the last decade , in part because of the winter ticks . The ticks infest moose and suck their blood dry , and sometimes tens of thousands are found on a single animal . <p> Maine has the largest moose population east of Alaska and was home to some 76,000 animals about seven years ago . Lee Kantar , Maine 's moose biologist , said that number might now be as low as 50,000 . <p> Scientists in Maine are entering the final year of a multiyear study of the moose population in its northern and western areas . <p> ( Copyright ( c ) 2019 The Associated Press . @@81342270 <h> Yohji Yamamoto delivered an ultrachic collection that was as controlled as it was poetic . <p> Climate change might be a bitch for the planet , but on Friday night , Yohji Yamamoto spun it to fabulous advantage . Backstage after the show , he spoke about having had the globe 's great scourge on his mind trough his design process . <p> Given the backstage bustle and the designer 's soft-spoken tone , the thought was difficult to track exactly . Asked how it manifested in the clothes , he pointed to the various geometric cutouts in a series of black dresses . A less-nuanced reading is that those dresses were just Yamamoto 's take on sexy . <p> But no matter . Even if the dystopian subplot did n't register with clarity , the show 's poetry ( another of Yamamoto 's descriptives ) certainly did . The collection was exquisite , a study in inventive , cross-cultural chic . <p> Yamamoto opened with a sheer black shirt bedecked with a swirling appendage that looked like a huge , discombobulated rose . It was worn with a slim skirt under a huge picture hat . This @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ @ which Yamamoto had his way . Looks with rippled , wired hems exaggerated tropes of an early 20th-century ladies ' wardrobes ; sleeker versions with strong mismatched shoulders worked a futuristic Forties vibe . On the softer side , a rumpled white-and-light-beige assemblage put an undone spin on the goddess dress . <p> A haute feeling permeated the cuts and attitude , the latter Yohji-fied with trainers ( he was there so long before the sneakers-with-everything trend ) and humble fabrics . Yet humble has its limits .
